attempts.summary: Configured node1's previously-unconfigured vtnet2 interface as a new OPNsense zone (opt1/"LANB") with static address 10.100.47.1/24, added a firewall pass rule for that zone, and configured node3's matching enp8s0 interface (10.100.47.3/24) via NetworkManager. Verified node3 reaches node1 directly on lan-b and, via an explicit host route through node1's lan-b gateway, reaches node2 on lan-a with a TTL decrement proving actual routing through node1. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full post-restart recovery of the lan-b zone, addressing, and cross-network reachability.
